intro.title: Explore our service and book according to your need.

features.title: Ritual Castings & Hoodoo
features.body: Experience powerful healing through Hoodoo and candle magic rituals tailored to your needs. The working is set around the matter you bring, whether that is protection, a clearing, or something that has stayed stuck.
points: Set around the matter you bring
Protection, a clearing, or something stuck
Hoodoo and candle magic, tailored to you

features.title: Digital Vedic Healings
features.body: Vedic healing offered at a distance, so the session can meet you without a journey to Dehradun first. The method stays the same as an in-person sitting. Distance only changes where you are while the work is done.
points: The same method as an in-person sitting
No journey to Dehradun required first
The session meets you where you are
features.imageAlt: A guided healing moment with a singing bowl

features.title: Divinations
features.body: Discover insights and guidance through card readings for clarity in your life. A reading shows what is present and what is pressing, so the next choice is easier to see.
points: See what is present and what is pressing
A clearer look at the next choice
features.imageAlt: Cards laid out for a reading

features.title: Meditations
features.body: Elevate yourself to your higher self using the ancient method of meditation. The sitting is guided and quiet, meant to settle attention and lift it toward the part of you that already knows the way.
points: An ancient method toward the higher self
